text:
Mina Lee: Quick callout 1: debate for the new Alerts creation form. Two patterns on the table: (A) immediate inline validation on blur with visible "Required" helper text; (B) lightweight inputs + a summarized error bar after submit that anchors to fields. Constraints: compact dashboard panel, keyboard flow, and voiceover ordering. Thoughts? Oscar Vega: Inline on blur is my vote. People want to fix fields in context. Summary bars can be missed when the panel is scrolled. Ruth Chan: For very tall forms summary can help, but only if we move focus to it and allow jumping to each error. If we keep inline by default, add summary fallback for multi-step or when viewport height < 560px. Devon Price: Important: reserved height for error messages to avoid layout shift when errors appear. Use opacity transitions only. Also we should use data-field-id mapping so server errors can anchor reliably. Mina Lee: Agreed. Copy example: inline error -> "Threshold value is required"; summary heading -> "2 problems prevent saving". For required markers: show asterisk visually but include an sr-only "Required" span so screen readers get the label. Oscar Vega: Small ARIA snippet we can reuse: ```
Threshold value is required
``` That announces immediately. Ruth Chan: For the summary bar pattern, set focus to the bar (tabindex=-1) and use aria-live="polite" to announce count. Then clicking a link moves focus to the errored field which should receive role=alert or be read via aria-describedby. Devon Price: Destructive confirmations: for deleting alert policies that affect downstream routing, use typed-confirm: message like "Type DELETE to permanently remove this policy." For simple toggles, modal+undo toast. Typed-confirm should be case-insensitive and trim spaces. A11yChecker: Accessibility checklist: 1) focus to summary or first errored field; 2) inline errors use role=alert; 3) summary uses aria-live and receives focus; 4) required markers readable by SR; 5) keyboard-only acceptance tests logged. Mina Lee: Proposed decision: default to inline-on-blur with touched semantics + reserved message height; show summary banner on submit for long forms or small viewports and move focus to it; typed-confirm only for high-risk deletes. I'll update the pattern library with ARIA snippets and copy examples. Any objections? Oscar Vega: No objections. Add acceptance tests: keyboard-only and VoiceOver read order. Ruth Chan: I'll add Figma mobile variants showing the banner fallback and the reserved spacing for inline errors. Devon Price: I'll add the server-client field-id mapping and a tiny CSS suggestion: `.error-text { font-weight: 600; }` to keep emphasis without relying on color. A11yChecker: Logged follow-up ticket A11Y-5123. Checklist appended to the design doc. Mina Lee: Thanks everyone 1 posting the updated spec in #patterns shortly. End thread.
